cause: The live browser export request was correctly rejected while the running backend still held the pre-fix persisted-figure comparison logic; the focused regression test reproduced the mismatch before the server reload.

evidence.ref: Browser export returned AI_REPORT_SOURCE_MISMATCH before backend reload; tests/test_report_export.py::test_persisted_report_export_is_bound_to_the_stored_revision passed after normalizing stable figure identity.

impact: Export was unavailable in the already-running browser service until the exact v1.8.6 backend process was restarted; no report content was fabricated.
lesson: A code-level export fix needs a live-service reload and one real browser request before the UI can be called accepted.
